en.t: "It is quite accomplished, and has a very Japanese elegance."

units.source_text: 宗助连忙说，“不愧是出自佐田先生之手啊。

en.t: Sosuke hurriedly said, "As expected, it truly is the work of Mr. Sada.

units.source_text: 就让我来给你织一条漂亮的腰带吧。

en.t: Then let me weave you a beautiful obi.

units.source_text: 我要设计个好款式，精心做一做。

en.t: I will design a fine pattern and make it with great care.

units.source_text: 对了，论手艺，秀男比我好，还是让秀男来织吧。

en.t: Actually, when it comes to skill, Hideo is better than I am, so let Hideo weave it after all.

units.source_text: 他是我的长子，你知道吧。”

en.t: He is my eldest son, you know."
